description:
`Components.Text` and `Components.TruncatedText` are thin
single-purpose wrappers. Under VDom they become helper functions
(`text/1`, `truncate/2`) returning `%VText{}` — the modules go away.
WrapAnsi.truncate_to_width logic moves into the painter at the leaf
where width is known.

Acceptance: callers updated; modules deleted; visible_width
calculation moves to LineBuf push path so width tracking remains
correct.
title: Collapse Text + TruncatedText into VText helpers
